components.purpose: Opening gradient banner (the 'Start with' part of the request). It is the top-of-page hero with a color gradient, so it covers the 'Join our team' heading, the banner text, and the button to open roles (one of its up-to-two CTAs). Its guidance places it at the top, and it is the right fit over Hero (which is image-beside-text) or PersonalizedBackgroundHero (only needed for audience-specific content).
